intent_scope.intent: Add multi-day drag-to-select on the week body that creates a spanning event across the dragged day range.
intent_scope.weekbody_note: CONFIRMED: no component, file, symbol or test named `WeekBody` exists anywhere in source. The string appears only inside .sdlc/ artifacts. The week body is composed by views/Week/components/Grid/Grid.tsx.

component_tree.composition: Grid.tsx renders AllDayRow (render-prop) > MainGrid (render-prop) > EventGrid, where EventGrid receives onAllDayMouseDown + onTimedMouseDown and both event layers.

timed_grid_body.note: TimedGrid owns the CSS-grid day columns via --calendar-column-count and takes a single onMouseDown for the whole column area.

day_columns.note: There is no per-day column component. Columns are CSS grid tracks generated from the `visibleDates: GridVisibleDate[]` prop; day identity is recovered from pointer x via useGridCoordinates, not from a DOM component.

geometry.note: getDateByXY(x,y) already resolves an arbitrary x to the correct day column. Geometry is NOT single-day-bound.

timed.constraint_detail: resolveDraftForPointer computes isSameDayDrag = pointerDate.isSame(start,'day'). Both the isUpwardDrag and isSameDayDrag branches are gated on it, so a pointer in a DIFFERENT day column falls through to resolvedStart=start / resolvedEnd=start+DRAFT_DURATION_MIN. Cross-day drag is silently discarded and collapses to a 30-minute event on the origin day.

all_day.constraint_detail: Click-only. On mousedown it derives startDate then hardcodes endDate = start + 1 day. No mousemove/mouseup listeners are registered at all.

state_owner.note: The store draft IS the live preview - the gesture writes it on every mousemove and both Week and Day render straight from it.

multi_day_rendering_already_exists.status: YES - the render half of this feature is already built.
multi_day_rendering_already_exists.implication: A timed draft whose start/end already cross midnight is automatically promoted into the all-day row as a spanning bar, and Grid.tsx already feeds the live draft through positionAllDayDraftEvent for column tinting. So widening the gesture to emit a cross-day range should light up existing rendering with little new layout code.

current_single_day_behavior.timed_grid: mousedown opens a 30-min (DRAFT_DURATION_MIN) draft; dragging vertically within the SAME day column resizes it (min one GRID_TIME_STEP = 15 min); dragging upward past the origin inverts start/end; dragging into another day column is ignored and the draft stays a 30-min block on the origin day. mouseup commits via draftActions.startGridDraft({activity:'gridClick'}).
current_single_day_behavior.all_day_row: mousedown immediately creates a fixed exactly-one-day all-day draft on the clicked column and opens the form. No drag at all. A second mousedown while drafting discards.
